apps.name: Hotels MUSE iPhone
apps.notes: v1.9: BUILD sheet no longer runs off the bottom of the screen — showSheet() now splits every sheet into a scrollable content area + a footer pinned below it holding the trailing action buttons (ROLL THE PERMIT DIE / DON'T BUILD always tappable; CheckBox excluded from the footer rule). No rule, price, stage-order, or copy changes; deeds.json and board.json byte-identical to v1.8. Internet multiplayer via relay room codes (4-letter code, addressed delivery; relay not deployed yet, internet play starts working once it is); LAN WiFi play unchanged. Free camera (orbit / pinch zoom / two-finger pan, RESET VIEW, 8 s idle focus close-ups) + photo-textured buildings: 19 tex-*.png cut from the real US MB 1987 photos (511,628 bytes total), wall-only facade plates + photo window quads; President wedge roofs taller (0.30) with alternating yaw; Bank body grey stone -> sampled cream 0xFFDED1A8 with the whole front as one photo plate (door/window quads removed). Waikiki/Safari facades fall back to flat cream (fronts unreadable in shadow) with photo window bands; Town Hall has no texture (declared gap). Backs/sides flat except Fujiyama (wraps) and Boomerang (per-segment plates). Kept from v1.6: real printed board photo + serpentine 32-space track (BUY 12 / BUILD 13 / One Free Entrance 3 / Build One Phase Free 3), portrait board fit, dice tray on east felt, Bank 1.0 x 1.0. v1.3 crash fix and v1.4 'Your turn' fix intact.
